items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Now, Emanuel Perez, is that right? Is it Perez? No. Yeah, he was a cornet player.

ctx.x: Did he play with other bands that you know of?

He played at other bands before he played with me. And he played with Bill and Terry Brass bands and things. He played with them. He played lots of bands in the city. Lots of jobs. He's a fine old man. And he was the one that connected us with Celestine, Frank Wilson. He was playing cornet and he did more plays. And he knew Celestine and he told us in Civil East band about Celestine. We went to see him and we got him. That's how we got together. Now, Emanuel Perez, is that right? Is it Perez?
